transcript.en: Hello English learners and welcome to EnglishPod.
transcript.zh: 大家好，英语学习者们，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

transcript.en: My name's Erica and I'm here with Marco.
transcript.zh: 我是艾瑞卡，我和马可在一起。

transcript.en: Hurry up, Marco, we've got a lesson.
transcript.zh: 快点，马可，我们要上课了。

transcript.en: We have a great lesson for you today.
transcript.zh: 今天我们为大家准备了一节很棒的课。

transcript.en: That's right, an elementary lesson about being in a rush and about giving directions when you're in a car.
transcript.zh: 没错，一节关于赶时间和在车里指路的初级课程。

transcript.en: We're going to listen to two friends who are getting in a car and they're getting ready to go somewhere and they're in a big hurry.
transcript.zh: 我们要听两个朋友上车准备去某个地方，而且他们非常赶时间。

transcript.en: So let's hurry up and listen to the dialogue.
transcript.zh: 那我们也快点来听这段对话吧。

transcript.en: No wait, I meant make a right.
Don't worry about it, just drive.
Oh no, the light is about to change.
I'm not going to run a red light.
The freeway will be packed at this hour.
Go on, get out of our way.
Geez, having a fit is not going to help.
Just go down here and we'll cut through Ashburn Heights.
transcript.zh: 就从这里下去，我们穿过阿什本高地。

transcript.en: I'm going as fast as I can.
Yes, we made it, 5.58 just before the library closes.
transcript.zh: 太好了，我们到了，5点58分，刚好在图书馆关门前。

transcript.en: So they were in a hurry and it was all just to get to the library.
transcript.zh: 所以他们那么赶，就是为了去图书馆。

transcript.en: Well maybe he was late returning a book or something.
transcript.zh: 嗯，也许他还书晚了还是什么的。

transcript.en: That's a bit dramatic just for returning a book.
transcript.zh: 光是还本书就这么夸张，有点戏剧化了吧。

transcript.en: All right, why don't we look at our language takeaway for today.
transcript.zh: 好了，来看看今天的语言要点吧。

transcript.en: Okay, on today's language takeaway we have five words for you today.
transcript.zh: 好的，今天的语言要点我们为大家准备了五个词。

transcript.en: Five really important and useful words that we found in our dialogue.
transcript.zh: 五个我们在对话中发现的非常重要和实用的词。

transcript.en: So let's take a look at the first one.
So what does it mean when I tell you to step on it?
transcript.zh: 那当我对你说 step on it 的时候是什么意思？

transcript.en: You might also say speed up.

transcript.zh: 你可以说 slow down（减速）。

transcript.en: Okay, so speed up and slow down.
transcript.zh: 好的，所以 speed up 加速，slow down 减速。

transcript.en: So our third word for today is having a fit.
transcript.zh: 今天的第三个词是 having a fit。

transcript.en: Well, this is a funny phrase and I think listening to a few examples of this phrase might help us understand its meaning a little bit better.
transcript.zh: 嗯，这是个有趣的短语，我觉得听几个例子可能能帮我们更好地理解它的意思。

transcript.en: Geez, you don't need to have a fit.
transcript.zh: 天哪，你不用发这么大的脾气。

transcript.en: Nothing is going to happen if we're five minutes late.
transcript.zh: 晚五分钟也不会怎样的。

transcript.en: My boss is going to have a fit if I don't finish this on time.
transcript.zh: 如果我不按时完成这个，我老板会大发雷霆。

transcript.en: I almost had a fit when my boss told me I had to work this weekend.
transcript.zh: 老板告诉我这周末要上班时，我差点发飙了。

transcript.en: So Erica, why don't you tell me what does it mean when you have a fit?
transcript.zh: 艾瑞卡，你来告诉我，have a fit 是什么意思？

transcript.en: It means you get really angry and you can't control your emotions.
transcript.zh: 意思是你非常生气，控制不住自己的情绪。

transcript.en: So maybe you start screaming and maybe some steam comes out of your ears.
transcript.zh: 也许你会开始大喊大叫，耳朵都快冒烟了。
好的，这就是 having a fit。

transcript.en: Okay, let's take a look at our next word now.
When you cut through something, it means you just go through.
transcript.zh: 当你说 cut through 某个地方，意思就是从那里穿过。

transcript.en: It gives you the idea that you go through something quickly.
transcript.zh: 它给你一种快速通过的感觉。

transcript.en: So I can say, let's cut through the park.
transcript.zh: 所以我可以说，咱们穿过公园吧。

transcript.en: Yep, or let's cut through the backyard.
transcript.zh: 对，或者咱们穿过后院吧。

transcript.en: And this takes us to our last word for today, shortcut.
transcript.zh: 这就带我们来到今天的最后一个词，shortcut（近路/捷径）。

transcript.en: Cut. This is a really common word and not many people know about it.
transcript.zh: 这是个非常常见的词，但知道的人不多。

transcript.en: It's two simple words that when you fit them together, the meaning changes.
transcript.zh: 这是两个简单的词，组合在一起后意思就变了。

transcript.en: It's a great example of this real English we talk about.
transcript.zh: 这是我们讲的真实英语的一个很好的例子。

transcript.en: And it means to take a shorter way somewhere.
transcript.zh: 它的意思是走一条更短的路线到某个地方。

transcript.en: So if I take a shortcut, I go the short way.
transcript.zh: 所以如果我走捷径，就是走更短的路。

transcript.en: Okay, so going back just a little bit to cut through.
transcript.zh: 好的，稍微回到 cut through 一下。

transcript.en: If I cut through the park, that's basically a shortcut.
transcript.zh: 如果我穿过公园，那基本上就是一条近路。

transcript.en: Now it's time to listen to our dialogue again, but this time it's going to be slower so then we can understand all these words that we've just talked about.
transcript.zh: 现在该再听一遍对话了，但这次会慢一些，这样我们就能听懂刚才讨论的所有词了。

transcript.en: No wait, I meant make a right.
Oh no, the light is about to change.
I'm not going to run a red light.
The freeway will be packed at this hour.
Go on, get out of our way.
Geez, having a fit is not going to help.
Just go down here and we'll cut through Ashburn Heights.
transcript.zh: 就从这里下去，我们穿过阿什本高地。

transcript.en: I'm going as fast as I can.
Okay, well I think that was a lot more clear this time.
transcript.zh: 好的，我觉得这次清楚多了。

transcript.en: You know, there was some great language in that dialogue and I would like to look at how we can put it together.
transcript.zh: 你知道吗，这段对话中有一些很棒的语言，我想看看我们怎么把它们整合起来。

transcript.en: Okay, so today on putting it together, we have three phrases for you.
transcript.zh: 好的，今天的整合运用，我们为大家准备了三组短语。

transcript.en: And we're going to show you how you can use these phrases like a native speaker.
transcript.zh: 我们会教你如何像母语者一样使用这些短语。

transcript.en: Okay, so all of these phrases we heard in the dialogue, why don't we start with the first one?
transcript.zh: 好的，这些短语我们都在对话中听到过，我们从第一个开始吧？

transcript.en: So in the dialogue, they say make a left here.
transcript.zh: 在对话中，他们说 make a left here。

transcript.en: Yeah, and we can extend this phrase to say make a right.
transcript.zh: 对，我们可以扩展这个短语说 make a right。

transcript.en: That would be the equivalent of saying turn left.
transcript.zh: 这相当于说 turn left（左转）。

transcript.en: That means turn the car 180 degrees all the way around.
transcript.zh: 意思是把车转180度，完全掉头。

transcript.en: So make a left, make a right, make a u-turn.
If you're ever in a taxi and you're telling the taxi driver where to go, this is the perfect way.
transcript.zh: 如果你坐出租车，想告诉司机往哪走，这个说法再合适不过了。

transcript.en: Make a left here, make a right there.
Okay, so let's move to our second phrase and it is, are you nuts?
transcript.zh: 好的，来看第二个短语，are you nuts？

transcript.en: So this is a great way of saying.
transcript.zh: 这是表达以下意思的一个很好的方式。

transcript.en: So when would we use a phrase like this?
transcript.zh: 那我们什么时候会用这样的短语呢？

transcript.en: If somebody has a bad idea that you don't agree with, you would say, are you crazy?
transcript.zh: 如果有人出了个你不赞同的坏主意，你会说：你疯了吗？

transcript.en: So Marco, let's stop this podcast right now.
transcript.zh: 马可，我们现在就停掉这期播客吧。

transcript.en: Okay, I think that's a good example of how we can use this phrase.
transcript.zh: 好的，我想这是如何使用这个短语的一个很好的例子。

transcript.en: So let's listen to some examples of are you nuts?
transcript.zh: 来听几个 are you nuts 的例子吧。

transcript.en: You want to get married now?
You only met her three weeks ago.
I'm not going to cheat on the exam.
So I think that's clear and now we can move to our third phrase, which is, let's take a side street.
transcript.zh: 我想这很清楚了，现在来看第三个短语，let's take a side street。

transcript.en: Again, so if you're in a taxi, this is a great way to suggest a route or suggest a direction.
transcript.zh: 同样，如果你在出租车上，这是建议路线或方向的一个很好的说法。

transcript.en: So we can take this phrase and extend it out with a few more words.
transcript.zh: 我们可以把这个短语用更多词扩展一下。

transcript.en: We might say, let's take Wilson Avenue.
transcript.zh: 我们可以说，走威尔逊大道吧。

transcript.en: So let's take a side street.
Okay, so now let's take a listen to this dialogue a third time at its normal speed and now you can understand everything that's in this dialogue.
transcript.zh: 好的，现在我们来听第三遍对话，原速播放，现在你应该能听懂对话中的所有内容了。

transcript.en: No wait, I meant make a right.
Don't worry about it, just drive.
Oh no, the light is about to change.
I'm not going to run a red light.
The freeway will be packed at this hour.
Go on, get out of our way.
Geez, having a fit is not going to help.
Let's go down here and we'll cut through Ashburn Heights.
transcript.zh: 就从这里下去，我们穿过阿什本高地。

transcript.en: I'm going as fast as I can.
Well this dialogue is all about driving, right?
transcript.zh: 嗯，这段对话全是关于开车的，对吧？

transcript.en: In North America, where both of us are from, driving is everything.
transcript.zh: 在北美，我们俩的家乡，开车就是一切。

transcript.en: When did you get a car?
My car I got when I was like maybe 19.
transcript.zh: 我的车大概是19岁的时候买的。

transcript.en: But I learned how to drive and I was driving already by the age of 16.
transcript.zh: 但我学开车，16岁的时候就已经在开了。

transcript.en: In many countries you have to wait until I think you're 18 to drive, but in North America everyone has a driver's license by the time they're 16 years old.
transcript.zh: 在很多国家你得等到我觉得是18岁才能开车，但在北美，每个人16岁就有驾照了。

transcript.en: Because everything is so far away that you need a car.
transcript.zh: 因为什么都很远，你需要一辆车。

transcript.en: Yeah, it's a lot less likely to have subways or trains to travel by in North America.
transcript.zh: 是的，在北美坐地铁或火车出行的可能性小得多。

transcript.en: All right, so now you have all the tools necessary to give directions the next time you're in a car or in a taxi.
transcript.zh: 好了，现在你已经掌握了在车里或出租车里指路所需的所有工具。

transcript.en: Well everyone, I really hope you enjoyed this lesson.
transcript.zh: 好的，各位，我真的希望你们喜欢这节课。

transcript.en: Now I want to remind you all to come to our EnglishPod website at EnglishPod.com and here you'll find a lot of tools to help you understand our podcasts better.
transcript.zh: 现在我想提醒大家来我们的 EnglishPod 网站 EnglishPod.com，在这里你会找到很多帮助你更好理解我们播客的工具。

transcript.en: So with that, until next time, this is goodbye.
